label: PF Backlog 490
title: Defect/RCCA: ensure_feature_item broke on Feature dataclass (.get on object swallowed) - backlog-e2e red
body:
Source: precheck --full (2026-10-08). NOTE: originally allocated BI-PF-0455, but a concurrent session
already pushed a DIFFERENT BI-PF-0455 (DOGFOOD e2e checker defect) to origin/develop, so this item was renumbered
to avoid the id collision.

DEFECT: `backlog_link.ensure_feature_item` read plan-feature fields with `(... ).get(...)`, but a plan feature is a
`Feature` DATACLASS (not a dict) -> `AttributeError` swallowed by `except Exception: return None`. So for a real
Feature OBJECT it returned None and created no epic (only dict callers worked), which red-lit `backlog-e2e`.

RCCA (5-Why): 1. backlog-e2e failed. 2. ensure_feature_item returned None. 3. It raised AttributeError on `.get`.
4. The code assumed a dict; the broad except hid it. 5. Guard: type-safe `_fget(feature, key)` + an object-path test.

Fix: `core/backlog_link._fget` + `ensure_feature_item`; test `test_feature_epic_object.py`. Verified:
`scripts/dev/e2e_backlog_check.py` -> E2E: PASS; `precheck --full` -> PASS (42 gates).

delivery.note: id renumbered from 0455 (collision); SHAs updated after the message-reword rebase
